comment: Ceilings checked by verify.mjs and verify-life.mjs. Each sits roughly 15% above the value measured on 2026-11-17 (in brackets below), so ordinary work passes and a real regression fails. Raise one only with a reason in the commit message.
codeBytesNote: HTML, CSS and JavaScript in demos/anatomy-studio, excluding vendor/, with LF line endings [about 390,000]
vendorBytesNote: three.js and its add-ons in vendor/ [1,074,790]
coreStageBytesNote: the five model files a phone loads before the studio is usable [8,986,857 since the models were packed with pack.mjs on 2026-11-27; 16,050,540 before]
baseModelBytesNote: all ten base model files, which a desktop visit loads [19,118,004 packed; 34,464,408 before]
drawCallsNote: per frame in the opening view with every system loaded, plain rendering [2,276]
motionMsNote: CPU time for one step of the living body with the core systems loaded, averaged; machine-dependent, so the ceiling is generous [0.27 with every system on the development machine]
